# defectdojo_engagement (List Resource)

Lists the DefectDojo engagements the provider user may see, ordered by ID, with the display name `<product> / <engagement>`. Imports of scan results can create many engagements: filter by `product_id`. As after an import of an engagement, the tags of its product, which DefectDojo may add to it, are left out of `tags`.

Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. Terraform returns at most 100 results unless the `list` block sets `limit`. `terraform query -generate-config-out` writes every attribute that has a value, including those the provider otherwise leaves to others when they are not configured (such as `authorized_users` and `tags`): remove the ones another system manages before applying the generated configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the engagements of a product, and generate import blocks and
# configuration with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
# Imports of scan results can create many engagements: filter by product.
list "defectdojo_engagement" "shop" {
  provider = defectdojo
  limit    = 500

  config {
    product_id = 1
  }
}

# Only engagements whose name contains "pentest", ignoring case
list "defectdojo_engagement" "pentests" {
  provider = defectdojo

  config {
    name_contains = "pentest"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Only list the engagements whose name contains this text, ignoring case.
- `product_id` (Number) Only list the engagements of the product with this ID.
